categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests', but changes only `src/test/pow_tests.cpp` (+67/-0) to test proof-of-work calculation and difficulty verification.
categories.rationale: The test infrastructure category covers testing machinery, runners, and utilities, explicitly excluding tests that pin the behavior of a specific area. These unit tests target consensus PoW edge cases and belong to consensus/validation rather than test infrastructure.
